name: Riso
pitch: A warm community-conference talk that should feel like a two-ink print pulled off the drum that morning.

illustration.medium: flat vector styled as a risograph print, with visible color misregistration
illustration.line: 3px strokes that look slightly offset between color layers
illustration.shapes: simple bold shapes (circles, blobs, stars) with intentional layer misalignment
illustration.texture: grainy riso dot texture, slight color bleed at edges
illustration.palette_use: cream paper background dominant, indigo ink for line work, one hot pink used as the overprinted riso color
illustration.avoid: gradients, photorealism, perfect registration, glossy 3D, more than two ink colors
